The '''Cinnagar carbine''' was one of several [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] variants produced by factories in [[Cinnagar/Legends|Cinnagar]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Empress Teta system]], during extensive militarization efforts in the wake of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] of [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. This militarization continued through the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3956 BBY]], when this particular variant was available.
